items.docs:
Before sending a transaction request, save its data to the Partner's local database. In particular, the session ID and transaction amount information should be saved.

The request takes analogous values to the request transaction/register, except for two additional parameters used when requesting

params.name: sessionId
params.description: SessionId of the transaction given during transaction registration

items.docs: The method returns transaction information based on the sessionId field. For a single sessionId within a SIMP payment, multiple payments can be made on the IBAN, hence the API can return multiple objects.
